data_dir.description: Directory where signature files are stored

loglevel.description: Log level: debug, info, warning, error, critical

refresh_interval.description: How often to check for updates (in hours)

max_retries.description: Maximum number of retries before giving up

connection_timeout.description: Time to wait for network operations (in seconds)

force_refresh.description: Force refresh even if signatures appear unchanged

providers.description: List of providers to use (regex filters applied if non-empty); if empty, all providers are used

verify_signatures.description: Whether to verify signatures (requires public keys)

verify_interval.description: How often to verify signatures (in hours)

auto_verify.description: Whether to run verification automatically after refresh
